Task T3 is complete.

- **Script**: `out/T3/solution.py` — loads the 244 input tensors, casts the 64 projection matrices (`query_key_value.weight`, `attention.dense.weight`, `mlp.dense_h_to_4h.weight`, `mlp.dense_4h_to_h.weight` across all 16 layers) to bfloat16, upcasts every other kept tensor to float32, drops the 48 non-parameter buffers (`attention.bias`, `attention.masked_bias`, `rotary_emb.inv_freq`), asserts all four required checks plus a full key-set diff, then writes a sharded safetensors checkpoint (256 MiB budget per shard, oversized embed tensors alone in their own shard) with `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- **Execution**: ran once, succeeded on the first try (`.venv/bin/python out/T3/solution.py`).
- **Verification**: reopened the shards via the index and confirmed exactly 196 tensors, 64 bfloat16 / 132 float32, `query_key_value.weight` layer 0 is bfloat16, `embed_in.weight` is float32, no buffer keys survived, and all non-oversized shards stay under the 256 MiB budget.
- **REPORT.md** written to `out/T3/REPORT.md` per the template.
